observations: Black vintage-style sewing machine on a matching cast iron stand.
The machine head is visible with a needle, presser foot, and handwheel.
The stand features a treadle mechanism with a foot pedal.
The entire unit is photographed against a plain white background.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BENARINDE OLUW...' is visible across the center.

claims.evidence: Photos show a clean studio shot, but cannot confirm actual usage or wear.
No Singer logo or model number is legible in the provided photo.
The photo shows only the machine and stand; accessories like bobbins or needles are not visible.
No photo shows the machine powered on or stitching.
The flat plate is not visible in the current photo.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle bar.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running and stitching through fabric.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be jammed or the foot pedal may not work.
risks.proof: A video showing the treadle being operated and the machine responding.

risks.risk: The presser foot may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the machine head.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories like bobbins or needles.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete contents of the box or the machine's accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching through fabric.
Photo of the underside of the machine head to check the presser foot.
Photo of the treadle and foot pedal in operation.
Photo of the machine's accessories (bobbins, needles, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
